question: Does connection with one's own body differentiate the living-liberated person?
premises: Connection with other bodies does not differentiate the liberated person.
The living-liberated person still has a connection with his own body.
The analogy suggests the same non-differentiating status applies.
inference: For the living-liberated person, connection with his own body does not create differentiation.
plain_english: Just as connection with other bodies does not differentiate him, so too connection with his own body does not differentiate the living-liberated person.
